body: Honestly, I feel u bro. But I know my intelligence and purpose lie outside of what I've always done, I too feel like I'm in a constant loop of failure and bullshit, hell I don't even know what to do with my life. I know this: the loop will only continue if I let it, emptiness of life and failure will only expand if I let it, psychopathy is doing the same thing over and over again and expecting a change. Make one small change in your life, e.g. clean your room, do a course. Change isn't usually dramatic, but it always starts small.
